info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Warehouse Inventory Locations-v2-spec
info.description: The Warehouse Inventory Locations Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information on inventory locations within warehouses. This service is designed for logistics and inventory management professionals who need to track and manage stock placement efficiently. Users can retrieve a comprehensive list of warehouse locations to optimize inventory flow and enhance supply chain accuracy. Common use cases include integrating with inventory management systems and generating reports on warehouse layouts.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of inventory locations.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all available inventory locations, providing essential information regarding where inventory is stored. The response includes details that can help in managing stock more efficiently.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current inventory location.
